title: Stack N Snap deviled egg trays
text: Stack N Snap deviled egg trays. So... if you make deviled eggs to take any where... you NEED these.  The trays come out... stuff your eggs, set on the tray.  Then place the tray in the box (easy because of the finger holes conveniently placed on the ends - no fuss no mess).  Then snap on the lid and VIOLE!  No egg smell in the fridge.  Keeps nicely for home use or if your taking somewhere, a way to keep your eggs from being destroyed by the plastic wrap on top.  You can remove them from the boxes and put them on a decorative plate when you arrive.  You can also stack more than one set together. Daughter stole mine.  Ha.  So, I got more.  I highly recommend going for the set of 2.  I wash mine in the top rack of dishwasher, noooo problem.  These really take the yucky/messy parts about deviled eggs away!  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Snapware Snap N Stack 2-Layer Food Storage with Egg Holder Trays - 2 Pack
features: Included: (2) Snapware 2-Layer Snap N Stack Food Storage with Egg Holder Trays
Removable egg holder trays, for stackable convenience
Non-porous surface, will not retain odors, or flavors
description: Each Snapware 2-Layer Snap 'N Stack Food Storage container comes with (2) removable egg holder trays that can easily hold up to two dozen eggs. It is made of BPA-free clear polypropylene plastic that is food safe and makes it easy for the user to see the contents. The durable handles make it easy for the user to carry the container around. User also has the option to add and remove trays as per their requirement. User can also use it to carry food, treats and egg creations like deviled eggs to parties and picnics. This container is safe for use in the refrigerator and can be easily washed using a dishwasher (top rack for lids).
